auditMetadata.scope: Comprehensive Financial & Money-Related Utilities Audit & Enhancement

loan-calculator.name: Loan & EMI Calculator
criticalGaps: Missing term in years vs months toggle
Hardcoded $ symbol, missing multi-currency support (USD, EUR, GBP, DKK, PKR, INR, etc.)
Missing repayment frequencies (Bi-weekly, Weekly, Monthly)
Missing first-month breakdown and Year 1 totals (paid, principal, interest, balance after year 1)
Missing estimated payoff date based on start date
Missing annual repayment summary (Year | Opening Balance | Total Payments | Principal | Interest | Fees | Closing Balance) with expandable months
Missing advanced interest methods (Flat-rate vs Reducing-balance, Nominal vs Effective APR)
Missing fee modeling (Upfront processing fees, recurring monthly fees)
Missing prepayments / extra monthly payments / lump sum payoffs
Missing Pakistan KIBOR floating-rate integration and scenario stress testing
Missing Loan A vs Loan B scenario comparison
Missing visual chart (Principal vs Interest breakdown)
Missing CSV and Print export
loan-calculator.beginnerModePlan: Intuitive 3-4 input card (Loan Amount, Rate %, Term, Currency, Start Date) with clear plain-language labels, instant big stat cards, Year 1 summary, and interactive presets.
loan-calculator.advancedModePlan: Toggleable tabs: Fixed vs Floating (KIBOR / Benchmark), Flat vs Reducing, Fees, Extra Payments, Annual Amortization schedule with drill-down months, Loan Comparison (A vs B), and CSV Export.

mortgage-calculator.name: Mortgage Calculator
currentFeatures: Home price, down payment, rate, fixed term (10, 15, 20, 30 years)
Monthly payment, loan amount, total interest, total cost
criticalGaps: Missing LTV (Loan-to-Value) ratio indicator and warning if down payment < 20%
Missing housing expense components: Property Tax, Homeowners Insurance, Private Mortgage Insurance (PMI), HOA/Maintenance fees
Missing first-year summary metrics (Year 1 principal, Year 1 interest, balance after 12 months)
Missing full lifetime amortization schedule with annual aggregation and monthly drill-down
Missing term comparisons (10 vs 15 vs 20 vs 30 years side-by-side)
Missing extra payment modeling (accelerated bi-weekly, monthly extra, annual lump sum)
Missing optional Affordability & DTI (Debt-to-Income) estimator with disclaimer
Missing currency selector (USD, EUR, DKK, GBP, etc.)
Missing responsive breakdown chart and CSV export
mortgage-calculator.beginnerModePlan: Clear home purchase inputs with automatic down payment % and $ synchronization, monthly P&I display, LTV badge, and quick presets.
mortgage-calculator.advancedModePlan: PITI breakdown (Principal, Interest, Taxes, Insurance, PMI, HOA), Affordability Guidance with DTI benchmark (28/36 rule), Term Comparison Matrix, Amortization with Extra Payments, and CSV Export.

compound-interest-calculator.name: Compound Interest Calculator
currentFeatures: Principal, annual rate, time in years, compounding frequency (annually, semi, quarterly, monthly, daily)
Final balance, total interest earned, growth percentage
Year-by-year balance table up to 50 years
criticalGaps: Missing recurring regular contributions (monthly, annual, quarterly)
Missing contribution timing (beginning of period vs end of period / annuity due vs ordinary annuity)
Missing annual contribution growth rate (annual step-up)
Missing inflation adjustment (real purchasing power vs nominal returns)
Missing breakdown of Total Contributions vs Total Interest Earned
Missing Target Savings Goal calculator (how much to save per month or how many years to reach a target)
Missing visual growth progression chart
Missing multi-currency support and CSV export
compound-interest-calculator.beginnerModePlan: Simple wealth growth simulator with initial deposit, monthly contribution, return rate, time horizon, and visual stacked breakdown of savings vs interest.
compound-interest-calculator.advancedModePlan: Contribution timing (start vs end), annual contribution growth rate, inflation adjustment (real rate calculation), target savings solver, and complete annual projection table with export.

gst-vat-calculator.name: GST / VAT Calculator
currentFeatures: Base amount, tax amount, gross total
Country preset chips (India, AU, UK, EU, Nordic)
criticalGaps: Missing reverse calculation from tax amount alone
Missing itemized multi-rate invoice line items (multiple goods at different VAT rates)
Missing regional sales tax with dual component split (e.g. Canada GST+PST/HST, US State+Local)
Missing printable calculation slip / tax summary breakdown
Missing tax exemption toggle
gst-vat-calculator.beginnerModePlan: Instant 1-click tax addition/subtraction with presets for standard rates (5%, 12%, 18%, 20%, 21%, 25%) and explicit formula display.
gst-vat-calculator.advancedModePlan: Multi-item tax table, combined dual-tax rates (State + Local / GST + PST), reverse tax solver, and printable summary.

discount-calculator.name: Discount Calculator
currentFeatures: Percentage off, fixed amount off, sale price to original price
criticalGaps: Missing tax before vs after discount calculation
Missing quantity / bulk purchase discount calculations
Missing 'Buy X Get Y Free' / BOGO effective percentage conversion
Missing coupon combination (fixed coupon + percentage off)
discount-calculator.beginnerModePlan: 3 clean tabs for Percent Off, Fixed Discount, and Reverse Discount with live update and savings highlight.
discount-calculator.advancedModePlan: Tax calculation toggle (apply tax before or after discount), BOGO converter, and quantity multipliers.

discount-stacking-calculator.name: Discount Stacking Calculator
currentFeatures: Stacking gap, minimum threshold, quantity rules, VAT/sales tax, cashback
criticalGaps: Could benefit from maximum discount cap setting (e.g. up to 60% max)
Visual waterfall breakdown of price reductions
discount-stacking-calculator.beginnerModePlan: Simple sequential coupons list with immediate comparison between real discount and advertised sum.
discount-stacking-calculator.advancedModePlan: Discount cap, optimal ordering analyzer, cashback, and detailed receipt breakdown.

percentage-calculator.name: Percentage Calculator
currentFeatures: Percentage change from X to Y
criticalGaps: Missing step-by-step arithmetic explanation for students and beginners
Missing compound percentage change (successive percentage changes)
Missing percentage point difference vs percentage change distinction
percentage-calculator.beginnerModePlan: Sentence-style natural language inputs with real-time solutions and visual bar illustration.
percentage-calculator.advancedModePlan: Step-by-step mathematical breakdown, successive changes, and percentage point calculations.

reverse-percentage-calculator.name: Reverse Percentage Calculator
currentFeatures: Find original after increase or decrease
criticalGaps: Tax reverse presets (unvatting prices)
Multiple successive percentage reversals
reverse-percentage-calculator.beginnerModePlan: Simple before-and-after finder with highlighted 'common mistake' correction.
reverse-percentage-calculator.advancedModePlan: Margin-markup equivalence, unvatting calculator, and reverse compounding.

currency-converter.name: Currency Converter
criticalGaps: Missing bank spread / FX fee modeling (e.g. 1%, 2%, 3% markup or fixed transfer fee)
Missing effective received amount after real-world conversion costs
Missing buy vs sell rate spread indicator
Missing explicit disclaimer that indicative rate is not an executed bank wire rate
currency-converter.beginnerModePlan: Instant mid-market conversion with prominent currency swap button and popular exchange rates.
currency-converter.advancedModePlan: Real-world transfer fee calculator (bank spread %, flat fee, effective exchange rate, total hidden cost).

invoice-generator.name: Invoice Generator
currentFeatures: Dynamic line items (description, quantity, rate, amount)
criticalGaps: Missing payment terms and due date fields
Missing line-item discount or overall invoice discount
Missing shipping / delivery fee field
Missing currency selector (USD, EUR, GBP, DKK, CAD, AUD, etc.)
Missing tax exemption / multiple tax components
Missing notes / bank wire transfer details section
invoice-generator.beginnerModePlan: Clean invoice form with sample presets (freelancer, consulting, web design) and 1-click PDF download.
invoice-generator.advancedModePlan: Discounts, shipping, payment terms, bank wiring info, customizable currency, and professional invoice PDF styling.

tip-calculator.name: Tip Calculator
currentFeatures: Bill amount, tip percentage slider/presets (10%, 15%, 18%, 20%, 25%), number of people
Tip amount, total bill, per-person split
criticalGaps: Missing round-up to nearest dollar/euro/krone option
Missing tip on pre-tax vs post-tax option
Missing custom uneven split (e.g. person ordered extra)
Missing international tipping etiquette guide (US vs Europe vs Asia)
tip-calculator.beginnerModePlan: Fast mobile-friendly slider with instant per-person split and rounding toggle.
tip-calculator.advancedModePlan: Pre-tax tip setting, rounding up total vs per-person, and uneven bill splitting.

margin-vs-markup-calculator.name: Margin vs Markup Calculator
currentFeatures: Cost and Price, Target Margin, Target Markup modes
Profit, margin %, markup %, multiplier, step-by-step arithmetic
criticalGaps: Missing volume sales / gross profit projection
Missing discount impact on margin calculator
margin-vs-markup-calculator.beginnerModePlan: Clear explanation of the crucial difference between margin (profit/revenue) and markup (profit/cost).
margin-vs-markup-calculator.advancedModePlan: Volume break-even analysis and price markdown impact on margin.

pay-rise-calculator.name: Pay Rise Calculator
currentFeatures: Current pay, percentage or cash increase, hourly/weekly/monthly/annual conversion
criticalGaps: Missing inflation-adjusted real salary change
Missing estimated take-home tax impact
pay-rise-calculator.beginnerModePlan: Instant before-and-after salary and hourly rate calculator.
pay-rise-calculator.advancedModePlan: Real pay rise after inflation and multi-period breakdown.

percentage-difference-calculator.name: Percentage Difference Calculator
currentFeatures: Calculates absolute difference divided by average of two numbers
criticalGaps: Missing clear distinction between difference vs change vs error
percentage-difference-calculator.advancedModePlan: Comparison matrix between % difference, % change, and % error.

price-increase-calculator.name: Price Increase Calculator
currentFeatures: Original price and new price or percentage increase, step-by-step breakdown
criticalGaps: Missing recurring inflation over time
Missing volume impact / customer price sensitivity note
price-increase-calculator.beginnerModePlan: Quick price markup calculator with dollar increase and new price.
price-increase-calculator.advancedModePlan: Multi-year compounding price increase and basket impact.

unit-price-calculator.name: Unit Price Calculator
currentFeatures: Compare Package A vs Package B with price and quantity/weight
Shows cheaper option, price per unit, and percentage savings
criticalGaps: Missing multi-unit conversions (e.g. grams vs kilograms, ounces vs pounds, liters vs ml)
Missing 3-way or 4-way comparison
unit-price-calculator.beginnerModePlan: Side-by-side deal checker showing which product is cheaper per unit.
unit-price-calculator.advancedModePlan: Automatic cross-unit conversions (g, kg, oz, lb, ml, l) and 3+ package comparison.

camt053-to-csv.name: CAMT.053 to CSV Converter
currentFeatures: Client-side XML parsing of ISO 20022 CAMT.053 bank statement
CSV export of bank transactions, booking date, amount, debtor/creditor
criticalGaps: Missing CAMT.052 (interim report) and CAMT.054 (notification) dialect detection
Missing customizable CSV delimiter (comma vs semicolon for European Excel)
camt053-to-csv.beginnerModePlan: Drag-and-drop bank XML file with instant preview and download.
camt053-to-csv.advancedModePlan: Delimiter options, column filtering, and CAMT dialect verification.
